chunks: Yet they reject the Hour as untrue. We have prepared a Fire for those who deny the Resurrection.

key_terms.السَّاعَةِ: The Hour, referring to the Day of Resurrection or the time of the end

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for those who deny the Hour (Resurrection) according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the cognitive dissonance of the disbelievers who, despite witnessing clear signs, reject the Hour due to arrogance, thereby justifying the divine preparation of 'Sa'ir' (a blazing fire) as a precise retribution. It connects the metaphysical reality of the Resurrection with the tangible experience of punishment, reinforcing the concept of 'Adl' (Divine Justice) where denial leads directly to its corresponding consequence.
